segments.text: You guys are just gatekeeping, because women are hot, and you're fucking jealous, and you're like,
oh, I-I-I'm a better person than them, because they definitely haven't played the game,
They're not cultured like I am, and it makes me better than them.
And fuck these beautiful women for cosplaying a game that I like.
I can't be hot, so I have to have a personality over them.

I would never leave hate comments and shit, but at a time, I was a jealous bitch, too.

and I bet their personalities are so bad, like, they just don't have a personality.
